context: M7 o8. The Shamrock Rail, after the yes. Mayhew slides a paper bag along the bar.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Your old service piece. I kept it when they took your shield. Kept it oiled.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: You gave up the badge. The streets didn't give up anything. Take it.

lines.speaker: npc.off_duty_cop
lines.text: Back door! Somebody's at the back door with a gun!
